title: The Threat-Simulation Loop (Anxiety Pattern Core)
description: The core mapping — the anxiety pattern’s Signature model — is the THREAT-SIMULATION LOOP: generate(futures) → weight(worst-case, heavily) → act(avoid/prepare excessively) → skip disconfirmation (avoidance prevents the test) → repeat. The engine is SOUND; the parameters are skewed — asymmetric loss weighting plus a broken update rule. As design material this is every over-cautious system: the approval process that models only failure, the AI safety layer that blocks everything, the character who can’t act. The mapping models SHAPE, never persons. A Signature conceptual mapping by Justin Addam Higgins. Conceptual framework only — not medical fact, advice, or treatment.

title: Catastrophic Branching
description: Branching — the catastrophic — maps to a DECISION TREE explored depth-first down the worst branch: each node spawns children, attention follows the maximum-loss child, the tree grows exponentially while probability is ignored — expected value never computed. As design material this is scope creep in risk registers, the security review that enumerates threats without likelihoods, the AI planner exploring adversarial branches forever. The design operation: PRUNE BY PROBABILITY — force expected-value computation at each branch; cap depth. Risk work is tree-pruning. A Signature conceptual mapping by Justin Addam Higgins. Conceptual framework only.

title: The Body Alarm as Signal System
t: The Body Alarm as Signal System
description: The alarm — the body’s — maps to a SIGNAL SYSTEM with lowered trigger threshold: the smoke detector installed in the kitchen — it fires at toast, and each firing is logged as evidence the kitchen is dangerous. As design material this is alert fatigue, the monitoring system with thresholds set too tight, the character written with permanent adrenaline. The design operation: RECALIBRATE thresholds against base rates — count true vs false alarms openly. The mapping respects the alarm (it’s data) while questioning its calibration — a stance reusable for every noisy alert pipeline. A Signature conceptual mapping by Justin Addam Higgins. Conceptual framework only — not medical advice.

title: Avoidance as Update-Blocker
description: Avoidance — the pattern’s engine — maps to an UPDATE-BLOCKER: the prediction "X is dangerous" can only be falsified by encountering X, but avoidance guarantees X is never encountered — the belief is UNFALSIFIABLE BY DESIGN. As design material this is the untested assumption in every organization ("customers won’t like it" — never shipped), the AI model never evaluated on the hard slice, the writer who never submits. The design operation: SAFE TESTS — small, bounded encounters engineered to permit falsification. Falsifiability is the key node. A Signature conceptual mapping by Justin Addam Higgins. Conceptual framework only.

title: Reassurance Loops in Systems
description: Reassurance — the loop’s fuel — maps to a DEPENDENCY CYCLE: alarm → request reassurance → temporary relief → alarm returns stronger (tolerance) → request again. The reassurer becomes INFRASTRUCTURE the system can’t function without. As design material this is the team that can’t ship without sign-off, the AI that queries the oracle on every step, the dashboard refreshed compulsively. The design operation: RATE-LIMIT the oracle — scheduled check-ins replace on-demand reassurance; build the system’s own calibration. A Signature conceptual mapping by Justin Addam Higgins. title: Language Frame: Probability Talk
description: The frame — probability talk — replaces CATASTROPHE LANGUAGE ("what if X happens?!") with CALIBRATION LANGUAGE ("how likely is X? what would disconfirm it?"). As a logic operator, calibrate() forces the two missing computations — probability and falsifier — into the open. Writers use it to write characters who think clearly under pressure; AI designers use it to build personas that reason about risk well; facilitators use it to defuse spiraling meetings. The frame is COMMUNICATION CRAFT — never a clinical tool. A Signature language frame by Justin Addam Higgins. Conceptual framework only.

title: Metaphor Model: The Smoke Detector
description: The detector — the smoke — models the alarm as HARDWARE with a sensitivity dial: the device works (it detects), but the dial is set for a chemistry lab in a kitchen — correct device, wrong calibration. The metaphor’s discipline: it locates the issue at the DIAL (adjustable), never at the device (identity). Adjustable beats broken — in systems and in stories. title: Perfectionism as Infinite QA
description: Perfectionism — the pattern’s cousin — maps to INFINITE QA: the release gate requires zero-defect proof, proof requires exhaustive testing, exhaustive testing never completes — the product never ships. As design material this is the review process with no acceptance criteria, the AI alignment loop that never deploys, the writer’s 40th draft. The design operation: SHIP CRITERIA — define "good enough" BEFORE review begins; time-box the QA phase. Perfectionism is a missing stop condition — supply it externally. A Signature conceptual mapping by Justin Addam Higgins. Conceptual framework only.

title: The Control Illusion Dashboard
description: The dashboard — the control illusion — maps the pattern’s information hunger: more DATA feels like more CONTROL, so the system ingests endlessly — tracking, checking, researching — while controllability stays flat. Formally: d(perceived control)/d(information) > 0 while d(actual control)/d(information) ≈ 0. As design material this is the analytics addiction, the 40-tab research spiral, the AI context window stuffed past usefulness. The design operation: CONTROL BUDGETS — cap information intake per decision; decide at the cap. A Signature conceptual mapping by Justin Addam Higgins. Conceptual framework only.

title: The Preparation Paradox
description: The paradox — the prepared — maps OVER-PREPARATION as avoidance in disguise: preparing for X indefinitely postpones X while FEELING like progress — motion without movement. Formally: preparation utility is concave (diminishing returns) but the loop treats it as linear. As design material this is the startup in stealth mode for 3 years, the student who never submits, the AI trained past the point of usefulness. The design operation: SHIP THRESHOLDS — preparation ends at diminishing-returns crossover, decided in advance. A Signature conceptual mapping by Justin Addam Higgins. Conceptual framework only.

title: Uncertainty Intolerance as Type Error
description: The intolerance — the uncertainty — maps to a TYPE ERROR: the system demands BOOLEAN certainty (safe/unsafe) from a PROBABILISTIC world — the type mismatch throws an exception (alarm) on every uncertain input. As design material this is the spec requiring guarantees where only confidence intervals exist, the AI asked for certainty it can’t have, the contract with no force-majeure clause. The design operation: CHANGE THE TYPE — design for confidence levels, graceful degradation, and explicit unknown-handling. Uncertainty isn’t the enemy; the boolean demand is. A Signature conceptual mapping by Justin Addam Higgins. Conceptual framework only.

title: Panic as Cascade Failure
description: Panic — the cascade — maps to CASCADE FAILURE: a single alarm triggers body response, the response is read as CONFIRMING EVIDENCE ("my heart pounds, so danger is real"), which triggers more alarm — positive feedback with no breaker. As design material this is the incident response that escalates itself, the market flash crash, the AI agent’s error compounding. The design operation: CIRCUIT BREAKERS — pre-installed interrupts that halt the cascade at defined thresholds (in systems: kill switches; in stories: the character’s grounding ritual as plot device). Breakers are designed BEFORE the cascade, never during. A Signature conceptual mapping by Justin Addam Higgins. Conceptual framework only — not medical advice.

title: Hypervigilance as Always-On Monitoring
description: Hypervigilance — the always-on — maps to MONITORING with no sampling strategy: every input scanned at full resolution, no prioritization, CPU pinned at 100% — the system can’t idle. As design material this is the logging pipeline that records everything (and finds nothing), the manager who CCs themselves on all mail, the AI with no attention budget. The design operation: SAMPLING STRATEGIES — tiered monitoring (full-res on anomalies, sampled on routine), scheduled idle, attention budgets. Monitoring is a resource; budget it.
